books.title: Beyond Anxiety: Curiosity, Creativity, and Finding Your Life's Purpose
books.author: Martha Beck
books.description: Beck describes how the mind can lock into a spiral of worry and offers simple exercises for stepping out of it. She then turns to curiosity and creative play as the way to stay out, linking them to a sense of purpose, closeness with others and care for the wider world.
